title: Logit-Boundary Geometric Belief Interfaces and Sparse Sheaf-Enclave Protocols: A Self-Contained Substrate for Secure Network Electronic Health Record (EHR) Interoperability
abstract: arXiv:2608.10300v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Electronic health-record interoperability is a boundary problem: legacy systems, generative models, terminology services, identity systems, and human reviewers may each expose rich internal states, while operational exchange requires a narrow shared interface of typed claims, bounded uncertainty, provenance, and explicit admission or abstention. This paper details a mathematical and engineering architecture for that interface. The organizing idea is the logit boundary: a discovery model may propose pre-threshold scores over a local categorical decision, but a deterministic judgment substrate decides whether the proposal is admissible, requires review, or must be quarantined before any Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) transaction is constructed. translated_title: 基于逻辑边界几何信念接口与稀疏层丛包裹协议：面向安全网络电子健康记录互操作性的自包含基础架构
translated_abstract: 电子健康记录互操作性是一个边界问题：传统系统、生成模型、术语服务、身份系统以及人工审核者可能各自暴露丰富的内部状态，而实际交换需要一种狭窄的共享接口，该接口包含类型化声明、有限不确定性、来源信息以及明确的接受或弃权机制。本文详细阐述了该接口的数学与工程架构。核心思想是逻辑边界：发现模型可以在局部分类决策上提出阈值前的分数，但一个确定性判断基础架构决定该提议是否可接受、是否需要审核，或在构建任何快速医疗互操作性资源（FHIR）交易之前必须被隔离。由此产生的几何信念接口（GBI）结合了有限边界语义、局部Dirichlet证据、细胞层与映射锥诊断、以及辅助几何自动编码器。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于逻辑边界和几何信念接口的新型架构，通过确定性判断机制和稀疏层丛包裹协议，实现了安全且自包含的电子健康记录互操作性，解决了传统系统与生成模型之间的边界信任问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel architecture based on logit boundaries and geometric belief interfaces, enabling secure and self-contained EHR interoperability through deterministic judgment mechanisms and sparse sheaf-enclave protocols, addressing boundary trust issues between legacy systems and generative models.
